# Camera tile (`camera-tile`)

A still picture that refreshes on a timer, with a name, status line and placeholder.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createCameraTile` (types in `dist/web/home/cameraTile.d.ts`): `.mh-camera-tile` (`.is-empty` without a picture): a `<figure>` with a `__frame` at the given aspect holding a `__placeholder` camera icon and, over it, the `__image` (lazy, no referrer); a `<figcaption>` `__caption` with `__text` (`__name`, `__status`) and an `__action` slot (`caption: false` leaves the caption out). With `refreshEvery`, frames refresh as `watchCameraRefresh` describes; a failed first load shows the placeholder. `onOpen` makes the frame a button (`.is-openable`); `updated` adds an `__updated` age label over the frame.

```ts
export function createCameraTile(options: CameraTileOptions): CameraTileHandle;

export interface CameraTileOptions {
  /** Any image URL, or null when there is no picture. */
  src: string | null;
  /** The camera's name; also the picture's alternative text. */
  name: string;
  /** A status line ("Motion · 2 min ago"). */
  status?: string | null;
  /** Reloads the picture every this many seconds (a cache-busting query parameter), while it is visible. */
  refreshEvery?: number | null;
  /** Width / height of the picture (default 16 / 9). */
  aspect?: number;
  /** A control in the caption row (a button). */
  action?: HTMLElement | null;
  /** Show the caption row (default true); leave it out where a card's header already names the camera. */
  caption?: boolean;
  /** Tapping the picture (or Enter / Space on it) opens it, e.g. full screen. */
  onOpen?: (() => void) | null;
  /** Show how old the picture is ("Updated 2 min ago") over its corner, from when the last frame arrived. */
  updated?: boolean;
}

export interface CameraTileHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  update(options: CameraTileOptions): void;
  /** Reloads the picture now. */
  refresh(): void;
  /** Stops refreshing. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createCameraTile, createIconButton } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const refresh = createIconButton({
  icon: 'refresh',
  label: 'Refresh Front door',
  size: 'small',
  onClick: () => camera.refresh(),
});

const camera = createCameraTile({
  src: '/snapshots/front-door.jpg',
  name: 'Front door',
  status: 'Motion · 2 min ago',
  // Reloads the picture every 10 seconds while it is on screen.
  refreshEvery: 10,
  action: refresh.el,
});

document.body.append(camera.el);
```

## React API

`CameraTile` (types in `dist/react/home.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createCameraTile`; refreshes with the same off-screen loading and visibility rules.

```ts
export function CameraTile({ src, name, status, refreshEvery, aspect, action, caption = true, onOpen, updated, className }: CameraTileProps);

export interface CameraTileProps extends Omit<CameraTileOptions, 'action'> {
  /** A control in the caption row (a button). */
  action?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example
